rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial way to describe doing something impressively or powerfully.

example.english: They played formidably and won the final.
example.traditional: 佢哋好犀利咁踢波，最後贏咗場決賽。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 hou2 sai1 lei6 gam3 tek3 bo1 zeoi3 hau6 jeng4 zo2 coeng4 kyut3 coi3

rows.note: Use this when the formidable quality comes from an imposing presence, manner, or display of power.

example.english: The whole team of bodyguards entered the venue formidably in a line.
example.traditional: 成隊保鑣一字排開，好有威勢咁行入會場。
example.jyutping: sing4 deoi6 bou2 biu1 jat1 zi6 paai4 hoi1 hou2 jau5 wai1 sai3 gam3 haang4 jap6 wui2 coeng4

rows.jyutping: ling6 jan4 mong6 ji4 sang1 wai3 gam3
rows.note: Use this when the manner is specifically intimidating or makes people feel afraid to challenge the person.

example.english: They guarded the entrance formidably, and nobody dared approach.
example.traditional: 佢哋令人望而生畏咁守住門口，冇人敢行近。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 ling6 jan4 mong6 ji4 sang1 wai3 gam3 sau2 zyu6 mun4 hau2 mou5 jan4 gam2 haang4 kan5
